assign.layer: Spark UI, Status Store and Metrics

appendDesc.RDD Library and Shared Variables: Also covers the remaining RDD classes: pipe, sampling, subtract, partition pruning, partitioner aware union, zip with index, checkpoint RDDs, JDBC input, the periodic checkpointer and the RDD operation scope used to label jobs in the UI.
appendDesc.Shuffle and Block Storage: Also covers the block transfer service (BlockTransferService and its Netty implementation) used to fetch and push blocks between executors.

tour.title: Moving blocks between executors: the block transfer service
tour.description: When a task needs a block held by another executor, the BlockManager asks a BlockTransferService. The Netty implementation (NettyBlockTransferService) opens a client connection configured by SparkTransportConf, and the serving side NettyBlockRpcServer answers fetch and upload requests by reading from the local BlockDataManager.
